g.text: Job Allocation — Layered Architecture (UML 2.5.1 package diagram, as built after refactoring)
Enforced by ArchitectureTest (7 rules): web never imports persistence; business never imports
persistence.orm, ormdao, memory, dialect or JDBC; persistence never imports business, web or adapter;
adapter never imports web; no tier imports storage or tool (only App and tools choose a storage).
Before the refactoring, web imported JobCriteria and TransactionManager and business decoded
SQL error codes (8 violations); now there are no exceptions.
